description:
## Outcome

The Mix release builder produces each first-matrix archive with application code, a target-specific private OTP runtime, packaged runtime data, launchers, license files, and metadata. It preserves fast dispatch and paint-first startup.

## Work

1. Implement the Mix release method confirmed by `jido_cli-tqg.7.14`.
2. Build the exact target layout and archive names in the artifact contract.
3. Include `llm_db`, `req_llm`, `time_zone_info`, `extractous_ex`, and all other required runtime resources without broken `priv` links.
4. Make launchers resolve paths relative to themselves and invoke only the private runtime.
5. Make the launcher enter the CLI before application startup. Do not expose a release `eval` expression as the public command contract.
6. Preserve fast help and version dispatch, the paint-first TUI, arguments, standard streams, signals or console events, and exit statuses.
7. Make build inputs explicit and pin OTP, Elixir, package, and native dependency versions.
8. Normalize timestamps, ordering, and permissions where the platform format permits repeatable archives.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each first target builds on its suitable native runner.
- [ ] The archive passes layout validation and can move after extraction.
- [ ] Removing system OTP does not affect the packaged command.
- [ ] TUI, `run`, `eval`, and foreground daemon modes start from the package.
- [ ] Fast help and version return before runtime startup.
- [ ] The first TUI frame appears before runtime-ready state.
- [ ] All required `priv` files and native libraries load from the package.
- [ ] Paths with spaces and Unicode work.
- [ ] Two builds from the same controlled inputs have matching content or a documented signed-build variance.

## Tests

Run builder unit checks, archive validation, focused startup checks, and the packaged-artifact harness on every target.

## Non-goals

Do not cross-compile unsupported targets, add hot upgrades, or keep a rejected package method.
title: Implement the selected private-OTP artifact builder
